reuse.why: The new action shares category selection with existing actions and reuses spreadsheet, batching, budget-writing, and undo abstractions, while repeating their iteration pattern.

duplication.why: Shared selection removes repeated category queries, although the new action repeats the existing income-check, amount-conversion, and budget-write loop.

placement.why: Selection policy and budget operations remain in actions.ts, with method registration and undo wrapping in app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide policies, new action, associated tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared exclusion predicate provides a clear maintenance point, with minor remaining repetition in action orchestration and income eligibility.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions use isSkippedByMonthActions directly or through getMonthActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining action-loop repetition is explicit rather than concealed through restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories is added to both shared helpers, and isSkippedByMonthActions conditionally disables hidden-category exclusion; fixed-group and saved-template exclusions remain shared.
